text: We are inside the contention period, and so we are applying when the coordinator works in beacon enabled mode. We are applying during the contention period this kind of slotted CSMACA. So let me just consider the case where okay we know that a sensor that has got the packet has to run all these steps of the algorithms of the inner and outer block, but let me just consider that at a certain point in time our sensor, transmit can transmit on the channel its data packet, okay. And we said well in this case, we are applying stop and wait right, and if the sync receives correctly the data will send back the acknowledgement, otherwise the acknowledgement clearly is not there, okay. One thing that we need to say is that this acknowledgement will be sent back by the access point after a time that is again called sives, okay. And during these sives, the sorry access point the sync, the sync during these sives performs the turnaround of its transceiver. Also in this case our nodes are half duplex, they can not transmit and receive at the same time. They are very simple nodes with only one transceiver.
